title: Our $445M Series D
summary: Oxide Computer announced a $445M Series D funding round, representing a significant milestone for the company focused on reimagining server hardware through deep hardware-software co-design with an emphasis on security and operational simplicity.
problem_solved: Traditional server infrastructure lacks modern security practices, operational simplicity, and tight hardware-software integration that Oxide addresses through their first-principles approach.
why_valuable: The substantial funding validates the market opportunity for next-generation server infrastructure that tackles fundamental architectural limitations in enterprise hardware.
